body: The TEOS10 reference heat capacity is now accessible via ```julia SeawaterPolynomials.TEOS10.teos10_reference_heat_capacity ``` Here's a description of the TEOS10 reference heat capacity: from the [TEOS10 manual](http://www.teos-10.org/pubs/TEOS-10_Manual.pdf) (equation 3.3.3, section 3.3, page 27).
title: Add TEOS10 heat capacity, plus some comments about TEOS10 implementation
